'''Swamp wampas''' were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] predators naturalized to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], related to the [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] of the plane [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="CSWE" />

The only major differences between the two [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammal]] [[Species/Legends|relatives]] was that the ice wampas had adapted to their surroundings with heavy fur coats to survive the harsh climate of the ice world; the swamp wampas, in comparison, had lighter, [[Color/Legends|dark brown]] coats, adapted to the swamps,<ref name="CSWE" /> bogs,<ref name="DF5" /> and marshes of Dromund Kaas.<ref name="CSWE" /> The pair of three [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall species were so similar that scientists believed swamp wampas may have directly descended from ice wampas, but the exact manner of their migration was unknown.<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the wampa-infested swamps beyond the [[Dark Force Temple]].<ref name="Story">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_story.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Story}}</ref> The [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] instinctively built cave-like hovels out of bog moss to ambush and store prey.<ref name="CSWE" /> During her trek through the twisted swamp, Jade passed by many of these "caves".<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Games such as Shadows of the Empire and Mysteries of the Sith didn't feel the need to confine such a fun enemy to Hoth, plogging down (re-colored) wampas in rocky and marshy settings and giving rise to the in-universe variants known as cliff wampas and swamp wampas.|[[Daniel Wallace]]|<ref name="Insider 102">{{InsiderCite|102|The Toughest Ever Creatures|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
Swamp wampas appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'',<ref name="MOTS" /> released on [[February 16]], [[1998]]. The species was simultaneously identified three days prior on the [[LucasArts]] website covering the game's features,<ref name="Features">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref> story,<ref name="Story" /> and FAQs.<ref name="FAQ">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_faq.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - FAQ}}</ref>
